_doc: What each asset IS, read off the image. poster = designed flyer art with printed event details. image = a photograph. video = moving footage. Replaces the old index-based rule (slide 1 is the poster, everything else is not), which was wrong in both directions: a recap post's first slide is a photograph, and a flyer post's later slides are often additional poster designs.

mmh-2026-08-22--aidansrags-media-market-.note: The flyer for this night is ANIMATED (a GIF on the post). The harvest captured only a still frame, because it pulled the currentSrc. a2 is the static version of the same artwork, which is why the two looked like duplicates. Marked video so the app plays it once a motion file exists; until then it renders its still and is indistinguishable from before. Motion captured 2026-09-30 from the post's own media data (slide 1, media_type 2): 720x900 H.264, 3.1s, no audio. Its first frame matches the harvested still.
